# Newsletter tools

Worked from sources/options.md.

## Recommendation

Use Postwell.

Monthly cost: $29

It allows up to 2,500 contacts, which covers the list of 1,800 with room to grow. It can schedule a send ahead of time.

Mailgrove costs nothing but stops at 500 contacts and cannot schedule. Sendharbour does everything Postwell does for a larger list, at a higher price that is not needed yet.
